name: Volumetric Path Tracing with Transmittance Sampling
definition: A rendering algorithm that samples the distance to the next scattering event or surface intersection using the transmittance distribution, handling both volume scattering and surface emission.
summary: Volumetric Path Tracing with Transmittance Sampling is a unidirectional method for single-scattering radiance that samples interaction distance from the transmittance distribution, explicitly handling surface intersections unlike delta tracking.
